crossRefs.note: Now after the death of Jehoiada, the princes of Judah came, and bowed down to the king. Then the king listened to them.
The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit. He has ceased to be wise and to do good.
But my people didn’t listen to my voice. Israel desired none of me.
So I let them go after the stubbornness of their hearts, that they might walk in their own counsels.
But as for those who turn away to their crooked ways, Yahweh will lead them away with the workers of iniquity. Peace be…
Then he says, ‘I will return into my house from which I came out,’ and when he has come back, he finds it empty, swept…
Then he goes, and takes with himself seven other spirits more evil than he is, and they enter in and dwell there. The…
even he whose coming is according to the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders,
but chiefly those who walk after the flesh in the lust of defilement and despise authority. Daring, self-willed, they…
Yet in the same way, these also in their dreaming defile the flesh, despise authority, and slander celestial beings.

parallels.note: Then he says, ‘I will return into my house from which I came out,’ and when he has come back, he finds it empty, swept…

translations.web: When he returns, he finds it swept and put in order.
translations.bsb: On its return, it finds the house swept clean and put in order.
translations.kjv: And when he cometh, he findeth it swept and garnished.
translations.asv: And when he is come, he findeth it swept and garnished.
